translationRepairs: When Wenheti's son Heduo Han and other splinter chiefs dragged their clans westward, deserting their father, Fei overtook them at Shangjun with a flying column and took Heduo Han's head.

蠕蠕別主 modifies 縕紇提, not 曷多汗; the original makes Heduo Han a splinter chief. The proposed sentence remains ambiguous in English, so the title is attached to Wenheti by apposition.

Helin came after him with four thousand foot and horse as far as the Gu River; Fei wheeled from Weichang, struck, and seized two hundred armored riders.
泒水 is the Gu River; Bosi would render 波斯, a different name.

Helin with four thousand foot and horse pursued Fei to the Gu River; Fei from Weichang struck them and took two hundred armored riders.
The literal line repeats the same 泒水 / Bosi error.
